questions.prompt: For the history of the previous question, is `git merge feature` from main a fast-forward?
options: Yes: they share C1, which is enough for Git to fast-forward
No: main's tip C2 is not an ancestor of C4, so a merge commit is created
No: Git cannot merge diverged branches without first rebasing one of them
Yes: feature has more commits, so Git simply moves the main pointer forward
questions.explanation: A fast-forward needs the current tip to be an ancestor of the other branch's tip.
